name: Roland Møller
bio: Roland Møller is a Danish actor. He won the Bodil Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role for Land of Mine, and Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Nordvest. He has appeared in high-profile films like A Hijacking, Darkland, Atomic Blonde, Papillon, and Skyscraper.
